metadata.description: Log Analytics workspace name that Microsoft Sentinel is enabled on
Resource name of the analytics rule 'Azure - Key Vault Secret Access Spike Per Identity'

properties.displayName: Azure - Key Vault Secret Access Spike Per Identity
properties.description:
Detects an identity accessing > 25 distinct Key Vault secrets / keys / certs
within 1 hour, where that access rate is a statistical outlier against the
identity's own prior 14 days. Indicator of credential harvesting after
compromise of an SP / managed identity (Storm-0558-style).
properties.query:
let abs_threshold = 25;
let excluded_identities = dynamic([]);
let baseline =
  AzureDiagnostics
  | where TimeGenerated between (ago(14d) .. ago(1h))
  | where ResourceType == "VAULTS" and ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT"
  | where OperationName has_any ("SecretGet","KeyGet","CertificateGet")
  | extend Identity = coalesce(tostring(identity_claim_upn_s), tostring(identity_claim_appid_g_s))
  | where isnotempty(Identity)
  | summarize HourlyDistinct = dcount(id_s) by Identity, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
  | summarize MeanH = avg(HourlyDistinct), StdH = stdev(HourlyDistinct) by Identity;
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ResourceType == "VAULTS" and ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT"
| where OperationName has_any ("SecretGet","KeyGet","CertificateGet")
| extend Identity = coalesce(tostring(identity_claim_upn_s), tostring(identity_claim_appid_g_s))
| where isnotempty(Identity) and Identity !in (excluded_identities)
| summarize DistinctSecrets = dcount(id_s), LastAccess = max(TimeGenerated),
            Vaults = make_set(Resource, 10),
            IPs = make_set(CallerIPAddress, 10), Ops = make_set(OperationName, 10)
          by Identity
| where DistinctSecrets >= abs_threshold
| join kind=leftouter baseline on Identity
| extend AnomalyScore = iff(StdH > 0, (todouble(DistinctSecrets) - MeanH) / StdH, 99.0)
| where AnomalyScore > 3.0 or isnull(MeanH)
| project TimeGenerated = LastAccess, Identity, DistinctSecrets, MeanH, StdH,
          AnomalyScore, Vaults, IPs, Ops

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Key Vault secret access spike by {{Identity}}
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{Identity}} read {{DistinctSecrets}} distinct Key Vault objects in one hour, far above its own baseline. Review the vaults and caller addresses before assuming rotation tooling.
